newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISA OTC SHARES TO ENTER BOURSE MAY 12.
newsitem.headline: POLISA OTC SHARES TO ENTER BOURSE MAY 12.

text.p: Polish insurance firm Polisa SA's 4.27 million shares, listed on the over-the-counter market until March 21, will enter the Warsaw bourse on May 12, the president of the bourse said.
Polisa previously had part of its shares listed on the Warsaw bourse and part on the over-the-counter market.
"The first listing of Polisa's shares series G and K will take place on May 12," Wieslaw Rozlucki said.
Currently there are 4.1 million Polisa shares trading on the bourse. Polisa has a total of 10.8 million shares outstanding. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
